tagline: Your Entire Factory. One Intelligent Platform.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a commercially ready, enterprise-grade Industrial Operating System called FactoryOS tailored for general manufacturing factory owners.
Do NOT show a login gate: default landing route '/' immediately enters the main Factory Owner workspace with Demo Owner profile ('Marcus Vance - Managing Director, Apex Precision Engineering').
Display a prominent 'Demonstration Mode' / 'Live Simulation' pill badge in the header/topbar with an info tooltip explaining all metrics and telemetry are active simulated demonstration data.
Include full navigation sidebar with 10 sections: Overview (Dashboard), Orders, Attendance, Production, Machines, Inventory, Schedule, AI Assistant, Reports, Settings.
Implement simulated real-time telemetry (simulated updates/polling toggle, live machine status pulses, alerts ticker).
Add responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts with collapsible sidebar, crisp mobile sheet drawer, and sticky top header with search & quick actions.
Every interactive button, tab, search input, filter, modal trigger, and row action MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML select/inputs. Use shadcn/ui components (Select, Dialog, Sheet, Tabs, Table, Badge, Button, Input).

Maintain high APCA/WCAG contrast: dark navy surfaces (#0B132B / #0F172A) must have crisp white (#F8FAFC) headers and muted slate (#94A3B8) text; pure white cards must use deep slate (#0F172A) headers and slate (#475569) body.
Use subtle industrial emerald green accents (#10B981 / #059669) for positive KPIs, active machine badges, and primary action highlights. Avoid vibrating neon greens.
Provide CSV export download functionality on the Reports tab using real client-side Blob generation with sensible mock datasets.

In the AI Assistant tab, present a polished interactive chat window with factory prompt chips, message history, text input, audio mic toggle icon, and a clear enterprise status pill stating 'AI Engine: Standby (Integration Sandbox)' with helpful diagnostic guidance and simulated factory query assistant responses.

component_breakdown.Sidebar: frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx — enterprise collapsible navigation with active route highlights, factory switch dropdown, and owner profile card.
component_breakdown.Header: frontend/src/components/Header.tsx — sticky navigation bar with search bar (Ctrl+K), factory status badge (Live Simulated), quick notifications popover, date range picker, and shift status.
component_breakdown.OverviewView: frontend/src/components/views/OverviewView.tsx — 4 primary KPI cards (Orders, Attendance, Machines, Production), target achievement gauge, Recharts production trend area chart, machine live telemetry grid, real-time alert feed.
component_breakdown.OrdersView: frontend/src/components/views/OrdersView.tsx — Status metrics banner, search/status filter, rich interactive orders table, sheet slideout with full bill of materials, dispatch logs and customer details.
component_breakdown.AttendanceView: frontend/src/components/views/AttendanceView.tsx — Shift summary, department-wise donut chart, live punch-in/out log, employee directory with filterable tags and manual attendance log dialog.
component_breakdown.ProductionView: frontend/src/components/views/ProductionView.tsx — Department production charts, customizable measurement units (Units, Tons, Batches, Meters), rejection rate bar chart, efficiency KPIs, planned vs actual timeline.
component_breakdown.MachinesView: frontend/src/components/views/MachinesView.tsx — Machine directory cards with dynamic health meters, live simulated status pulses (Running, Idle, Maintenance, Offline), maintenance history timeline, manual maintenance trigger dialog.
component_breakdown.InventoryView: frontend/src/components/views/InventoryView.tsx — Raw materials vs Finished goods tabs, low-stock threshold alert cards, reorder dialog, supplier directory, stock intake modal.
component_breakdown.ScheduleView: frontend/src/components/views/ScheduleView.tsx — Daily/Weekly/Monthly calendar toggle view, maintenance shifts and order delivery milestones, event creation/edit modal with priority and participant assignees.
component_breakdown.AiAssistantView: frontend/src/components/views/AiAssistantView.tsx — Modern industrial LLM interface with prompt chips, simulated diagnostic responses, audio wave indicator, factory knowledge base search, and clear integration status.
component_breakdown.ReportsView: frontend/src/components/views/ReportsView.tsx — Multi-metric analytical reporting center (Production, OEE, Downtime, Attendance), date filter, interactive Recharts preview, and instant CSV export generator.
component_breakdown.SettingsView: frontend/src/components/views/SettingsView.tsx — Factory configuration, shift timetable definitions, alert threshold sliders, production unit manager, and simulated data reset tools.

accessibility.color_contrast: All text tokens meet 4.5:1 minimum APCA/WCAG ratio. Slate-600 on Slate-50 = 7.1:1. Slate-100 on Navy #0B132B = 14.2:1.
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria attributes on all icon-only buttons, modal dialogs, and simulated status indicators.
